# Introduction

The [OAQ platform](https://oaq.notf.in) aggregates air quality data from
multiple networks across India. This vignette maps every monitoring station
currently active on OAQ, split by provider:

| Provider | Network | Coverage |
|---|---|---|
| **CPCB** | Central & State Pollution Control Boards | National (cities across all states) |
| **Airnet** | CSTEP low-cost sensor network | Bengaluru |
| **Aurassure** | University Clean Air Network | Odisha + Bengaluru |

---

# Setup

```{r packages}
library(vayuayan)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(here)
```

```{r paths}
india_geojson <- "https://geo.bharatviz.org/geojsons/districts/India_LGD_states.geojson"
vignettes_dir <- here::here("vignettes")
fig_dir <- file.path(vignettes_dir, "figures/oaq_network")
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

---

# Fetch station data

```{r fetch-stations, cache=TRUE}
session <- oaq_session()

all_stations <- oaq_stations_table(session, c("cpcb", "airnet", "aurassure")) |>
  mutate(
    provider_label = recode(provider,
      cpcb      = "CPCB",
      airnet    = "Airnet (CSTEP)",
      aurassure = "Aurassure"
    ),
    has_pm25 = !is.na(pm25)
  )

cat("Total stations:", nrow(all_stations), "\n")
print(count(all_stations, provider_label, has_pm25) |> arrange(provider_label))
```

---

# India state boundaries

```{r india-map}
india_sf <- sf::st_read(india_geojson, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326) |>
  sf::st_simplify(dTolerance = 0.01, preserveTopology = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_make_valid()
```

---

# Station network map

```{r network-map, fig.width=13, fig.height=11, fig.cap="All OAQ monitoring stations across India, coloured by provider network. CPCB stations are the government reference network; Airnet and Aurassure are low-cost sensor networks. Filled points have a current PM2.5 reading; hollow points are offline."}
provider_colours <- c(
  "CPCB"           = "#2166ac",
  "Airnet (CSTEP)" = "#d6604d",
  "Aurassure"      = "#4dac26"
)

stations_offline <- all_stations |> filter(!has_pm25)
stations_online <- all_stations |> filter(has_pm25)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = india_sf, fill = "#f5f5f5", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  # Offline stations — hollow
  geom_point(
    data = stations_offline,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = provider_label),
    shape = 1, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0.5
  ) +
  # Online stations — filled, sized by PM2.5
  geom_point(
    data = stations_online,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = provider_label, size = pm25),
    shape = 16, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = provider_colours, name = "Provider") +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range  = c(1.5, 6),
    name   = expression(paste("PM"[2.5] ~ (mu * g / m^3))),
    guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "grey30"))
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(67, 98), ylim = c(6, 38), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "OAQ Air Quality Monitoring Network — India",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "CPCB: ", sum(all_stations$provider == "cpcb"), " stations | ",
      "Airnet: ", sum(all_stations$provider == "airnet"), " stations | ",
      "Aurassure: ", sum(all_stations$provider == "aurassure"), " stations\n",
      "Filled = current PM\u2082.\u2085 reading | Hollow = offline"
    ),
    caption = "Source: OAQ platform (oaq.notf.in) | Live station feed",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box      = "vertical",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40"),
    axis.text       = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_oaq_india_network.png"), width = 13, height = 11, dpi = 300)
```

# Provider-faceted view

```{r facet-map, fig.width=14, fig.height=5, fig.cap="Same stations faceted by provider. Note Airnet and Aurassure are concentrated in southern India while CPCB spans the full country."}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = india_sf, fill = "#f5f5f5", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(
    data = stations_offline,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = provider_label),
    shape = 1, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = stations_online,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = provider_label, size = pm25),
    shape = 16, alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = provider_colours, name = "Provider", guide = "none") +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(1, 5),
    name  = expression(paste("PM"[2.5] ~ (mu * g / m^3))),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = "grey30"))
  ) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(67, 98), ylim = c(6, 38), expand = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~provider_label, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "OAQ Provider Networks — Faceted",
    caption = "Source: OAQ platform (oaq.notf.in)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold", size = 11,
      color = "white"
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey30", color = NA),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_oaq_india_faceted.png"), width = 14, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Nearest CPCB neighbours for non-CPCB sensors

For each Airnet and Aurassure station, we find the **3 closest CPCB reference
stations** by haversine distance. This is useful for pairing low-cost sensors
with nearby government monitors for calibration or cross-validation.

```{r nearest-cpcb-table}
cpcb_stations <- all_stations |> filter(provider == "cpcb")
non_cpcb_stations <- all_stations |> filter(provider != "cpcb")

nearest_cpcb <- nearest_stations(
  non_cpcb_stations, cpcb_stations,
  k = 3, from_id = "id", to_id = "id"
) |>
  mutate(dist_km = round(dist_km, 2)) |>
  left_join(
    non_cpcb_stations |> select(
      from_id = id, non_cpcb_name = name, non_cpcb_provider = provider_label,
      non_cpcb_city = city, non_cpcb_lat = lat, non_cpcb_lon = lon
    ),
    by = "from_id"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    cpcb_stations |> select(
      to_id = id, cpcb_name = name, cpcb_city = city,
      cpcb_lat = lat, cpcb_lon = lon
    ),
    by = "to_id"
  ) |>
  rename(non_cpcb_id = from_id, cpcb_id = to_id)

cat("Non-CPCB stations:", n_distinct(nearest_cpcb$non_cpcb_id), "\n")
cat(
  "Distance range to nearest CPCB:",
  round(min(nearest_cpcb$dist_km[nearest_cpcb$rank == 1]), 2), "–",
  round(max(nearest_cpcb$dist_km[nearest_cpcb$rank == 1]), 2), "km\n"
)

nearest_cpcb |>
  select(
    `Non-CPCB station`  = non_cpcb_name,
    `Provider`          = non_cpcb_provider,
    `City`              = non_cpcb_city,
    `Rank`              = rank,
    `Nearest CPCB`      = cpcb_name,
    `CPCB city`         = cpcb_city,
    `Distance (km)`     = dist_km
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

---

# Bengaluru: sensor network and nearest CPCB matches

Airnet (47 stations) and Aurassure (1 station) are concentrated in Bengaluru,
making it the only city where multiple low-cost networks co-exist with CPCB
reference monitors. The map uses ward-level boundaries for spatial context.

```{r blr-boundary}
blr_geojson_url <- "https://geo.bharatviz.org/geojsons/cities/bengaluru.geojson"
blr_boundary <- sf::st_read(blr_geojson_url, quiet = TRUE) |>
  sf::st_transform(4326)
```

```{r blr-stations}
blr_bbox <- c(xmin = 77.3, xmax = 77.9, ymin = 12.7, ymax = 13.2)

blr_cpcb <- cpcb_stations |>
  filter(
    lon >= blr_bbox["xmin"], lon <= blr_bbox["xmax"],
    lat >= blr_bbox["ymin"], lat <= blr_bbox["ymax"]
  )

blr_non_cpcb <- non_cpcb_stations |>
  filter(
    lon >= blr_bbox["xmin"], lon <= blr_bbox["xmax"],
    lat >= blr_bbox["ymin"], lat <= blr_bbox["ymax"]
  )

cat("Bengaluru CPCB stations:", nrow(blr_cpcb), "\n")
cat(
  "Bengaluru non-CPCB stations:", nrow(blr_non_cpcb),
  "(Airnet:", sum(blr_non_cpcb$provider == "airnet"),
  "| Aurassure:", sum(blr_non_cpcb$provider == "aurassure"), ")\n"
)

# Nearest-CPCB pairs restricted to Bengaluru non-CPCB stations
blr_segments <- nearest_cpcb |>
  filter(non_cpcb_id %in% blr_non_cpcb$id) |>
  mutate(inv_dist = 1 / dist_km)

blr_cpcb_matched_ids <- unique(blr_segments$cpcb_id)
blr_cpcb_matched <- blr_cpcb |> filter(id %in% blr_cpcb_matched_ids)
blr_cpcb_bg <- blr_cpcb |> filter(!id %in% blr_cpcb_matched_ids)

cat("Matched CPCB stations:", nrow(blr_cpcb_matched), "\n")
```

```{r blr-map, fig.width=11, fig.height=10, fig.cap="Bengaluru sensor network. Triangles = Airnet (CSTEP) and Aurassure low-cost sensors. Filled circles = CPCB reference stations matched as nearest neighbours. Open circles = other CPCB stations. Lines connect each non-CPCB sensor to its 3 nearest CPCB stations; thickness and opacity ∝ 1/distance."}
provider_colours <- c(
  "CPCB"           = "#2166ac",
  "Airnet (CSTEP)" = "#d6604d",
  "Aurassure"      = "#4dac26"
)

# Short name: strip city suffix for labels
blr_non_cpcb <- blr_non_cpcb |>
  mutate(name_short = name |>
    stringr::str_remove(",?\\s*(Bengaluru|Bangalore).*$") |>
    stringr::str_trunc(30))

blr_cpcb_matched <- blr_cpcb_matched |>
  mutate(name_short = name |>
    stringr::str_remove(",?\\s*(Bengaluru|Bangalore).*$") |>
    stringr::str_trunc(30))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = blr_boundary, fill = "#f7f7f7", color = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  # Background CPCB (unmatched)
  geom_point(
    data = blr_cpcb_bg,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    shape = 1, size = 3, color = "grey70", stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  # Connecting segments
  geom_segment(
    data = blr_segments,
    aes(
      x = non_cpcb_lon, y = non_cpcb_lat,
      xend = cpcb_lon, yend = cpcb_lat,
      linewidth = inv_dist, alpha = inv_dist,
      color = non_cpcb_provider
    ),
    lineend = "round"
  ) +
  # Matched CPCB stations
  geom_point(
    data = blr_cpcb_matched,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    shape = 21, size = 4, fill = "#a6cee3", color = "#2166ac", stroke = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = blr_cpcb_matched,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = name_short),
    color = "#2166ac", size = 2.3, max.overlaps = 25,
    segment.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.4, force = 1.2,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  # Non-CPCB sensors
  geom_point(
    data = blr_non_cpcb,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, color = provider_label),
    shape = 17, size = 3.5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = blr_non_cpcb,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = name_short, color = provider_label),
    size = 2.2, max.overlaps = 30, segment.size = 0.3,
    box.padding = 0.35, force = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = provider_colours, name = "Provider") +
  scale_linewidth_continuous(range = c(0.2, 1.8), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_continuous(range = c(0.2, 0.8), guide = "none") +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(blr_bbox["xmin"], blr_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(blr_bbox["ymin"], blr_bbox["ymax"]),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Bengaluru Air Quality Sensor Network",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "CPCB reference: ", nrow(blr_cpcb), " stations | ",
      "Airnet: ", sum(blr_non_cpcb$provider == "airnet"), " | ",
      "Aurassure: ", sum(blr_non_cpcb$provider == "aurassure"), "\n",
      "Lines connect each non-CPCB sensor to its 3 nearest CPCB stations",
      " | thickness \u221d 1/distance"
    ),
    caption = "Source: OAQ platform (oaq.notf.in)",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 9.5, color = "grey40"),
    axis.text       = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_oaq_bengaluru.png"), width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

# Station count by state

```{r state-counts}
sf::sf_use_s2(FALSE)

stations_sf <- all_stations |>
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)

# Find name column in the GeoJSON
state_col <- names(india_sf)[grep("name|NAME|state|STATE", names(india_sf),
  ignore.case = TRUE
)[1]]
cat("Using state name column:", state_col, "\n")

# Snap coordinates to 0.0001-degree grid to eliminate floating-point topology errors
india_sf_snapped <- sf::st_set_precision(india_sf, 1e4) |> sf::st_make_valid()

stations_with_state <- tryCatch(
  sf::st_join(stations_sf, india_sf_snapped[, state_col]),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Spatial join failed (geometry issue in source GeoJSON): ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

if (!is.null(stations_with_state)) {
  state_counts <- stations_with_state |>
    sf::st_drop_geometry() |>
    count(state = .data[[state_col]], provider_label) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = provider_label, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
    arrange(desc(CPCB))
  cat("\nTop 15 states by CPCB station count:\n")
  print(head(state_counts, 15))
} else {
  cat("State counts not available due to source GeoJSON geometry issue.\n")
}
```
